entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: Icebound twin world of Kavaron near the supervoid Sothera, terraformed by Eumidians.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: Twin of Evendo and Kav homeworld, whose deformation rained debris on Evendo.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: Supervoid that Evendo and Kavaron orbit.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: Terrasymbiotic beings who are terraforming Evendo.

entities.name: Hearthhull
entities.description: Eumidian seedship that planted a brood on Evendo.

entities.name: Kavaronic Empire
entities.description: Empire planning to invade Evendo after the Eumidians finish terraforming.

events.summary: Hearthhull found the Sothera system and planted a brood on Evendo.
events.quote: Hearthhull , a Eumidian seedship, found the Sothera system by chance and planted a brood on Evendo.

events.summary: Kavaron's deformation rained debris on Evendo, warming it and waking the Eumidians.
events.quote: This warming triggered the first wave of Eumidians to awaken from hibernation

events.summary: The Kav declared peace with the Eumidians but by 4561 were preparing an invasion force.
events.quote: by 4561 they were preparing an invasion force in the planet's orbit

relations.quote: who are designing invasion plans to take the world for their own once the Eumidians have finished remaking it
